nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender at deployment; used by the onlyOwner authorization check.
Public boolean gate that the payable fallback requires before accepting ether; toggled by enablePurchasing/disablePurchasing.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by the constructor, transferring and the payable fallback.
Nested mapping (owner => spender => amount) tracking ERC20 allowances used by transferFrom and approve.
Public constant-supply value of 100000000 ether minted to the owner in the constructor.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner, guarding enablePurchasing and disablePurchasing.
Constant function returning the token name string.
Constant function returning the token symbol string.
Constant function returning the token decimals (18).
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Constructor that assigns the entire totalSupply to the owner balance.
ERC20 transfer entry point that delegates to the internal transferring routine with msg.sender as _from.
ERC20 transferFrom that checks the allowance, calls transferring and then decrements the spender allowance.
Private routine performing balance checks, overflow guard and the balances mapping updates plus Transfer event.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount, reverting if a non-zero allowance is overwritten.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Owner-only function that sets purchasingAllowed to true.
Owner-only function that sets purchasingAllowed to false.
Payable fallback that issues tokens for ether sent, sends ether to owner and emits Transfer/AltruismMode events.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance indexing and token crediting.
Miner-influenced timestamp emitted inside the AltruismMode event in the payable fallback.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
balances[_from] -= _amount arithmetic state write in transferring.
balances[_to] += _amount arithmetic state write in transferring.
owner.transfer(amount) external ether send executed before balances are updated in the fallback.
balances[msg.sender] += tokensIssued arithmetic state write in the fallback.
balances[owner] -= tokensIssued arithmetic state write in the fallback.
amount * 1000 unchecked multiplication that derives tokensIssued.
balances[msg.sender] + tokensIssued <= balances[msg.sender] overflow guard expressed as an unchecked addition.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf used to index the balances mapping.
Parameter _to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount of tokens to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the token holder whose allowance is spent.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the recipient address.
Parameter _amount of transferFrom, the token quantity transferred and decremented from allowance.
Parameter _from of transferring, source of the balance subtraction.
Parameter _to of transferring, destination of the balance addition.
Parameter _amount of transferring, quantity moved between balances.
Parameter _spender of approve, the address granted an allowance.
Parameter _amount of approve, the allowance value written to the allowed mapping.
Parameter _owner of allowance, the token holder queried.
Parameter _spender of allowance, the spender queried.
Local variable amount = msg.value in the payable fallback, used for the price calculation and ether forwarding.
Local variable tokensIssued in the payable fallback holding the number of tokens credited to the buyer.

edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender at construction time.
Constructor assigns the whole totalSupply to balances[owner].
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the spender.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping that is decremented.
Fallback credits msg.sender balance and emits events with the caller address.
AltruismMode event embeds block.timestamp, making the emitted data timestamp dependent.
onlyOwner modifier gates enablePurchasing.
onlyOwner modifier gates disablePurchasing.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner and reverts on mismatch.
transfer delegates execution to transferring with msg.sender as _from.
transferFrom delegates execution to transferring before updating the allowance.
transferFrom executes the allowance decrement after a successful transfer.
transferring executes balances[_from] -= _amount.
transferring executes balances[_to] += _amount.
Fallback performs the external ether send to owner before any balance state update.
Fallback credits tokensIssued to the buyer balance.
Fallback debits tokensIssued from the owner balance.
Fallback computes tokensIssued = amount * 1000.
Fallback performs the overflow guard on the buyer balance.
Unchecked subtraction writes the allowed allowance mapping.
Unchecked balance subtraction writes the balances mapping.
Unchecked balance addition writes the balances mapping.
tokensIssued addition writes the buyer entry of balances.
tokensIssued subtraction writes the owner entry of balances.
Overflow guard reads balances[msg.sender] in an unchecked addition comparison.
Local amount (msg.value) is forwarded to the owner via transfer.
Local amount is multiplied by 1000 to derive tokensIssued.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is stored in tokensIssued.
tokensIssued value flows into the buyer balance addition.
tokensIssued value flows into the owner balance subtraction.
The external ether transfer is performed before state finalization, allowing re-entry into the payable fallback.
_owner parameter is consumed by balanceOf to read the balances mapping.
_to parameter is consumed by transfer.
_value parameter is consumed by transfer.
_from parameter is consumed by transferFrom when indexing allowed and balances.
_to parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
_amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom for the allowance check and decrement.
_from parameter is consumed by transferring for the balance subtraction.
_to parameter is consumed by transferring for the balance addition.
_amount parameter is consumed by transferring for both balance updates.
_spender parameter is consumed by approve as the allowance key.
_amount parameter is consumed by approve as the allowance value.
_owner parameter is consumed by allowance as the first mapping key.
_spender parameter is consumed by allowance as the second mapping key.
Local amount is derived from msg.value inside the fallback and drives its pricing branches.
Local tokensIssued is produced and consumed entirely inside the fallback.
